text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's a beautiful morning, isn't it? A perfect day for experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I realized that rest is essential so long as we're alive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now, I want to put this energy to good use! Let's move forward in exploring the potential of body modification.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is in a good mood. She seems to have rested well.
